`spotface_outer_steps.step` is pzfreo/quiddity's `tests/fixtures/spotface_outer_steps.step`
at tag v0.2.2, copied byte for byte: an original analytic construction made for
quiddity-rust#118 by its `tools/make_spotface_fixture.py`, using only Python's standard library
and no third-party model or external dataset. A ⌀40 × 12 ring with a ⌀6 through bore and, from
its top mouth inward, a ⌀30 × 0.5 spotface, a ⌀20 × 2 outer counterbore step and a ⌀12 × 3
counterbore, each depth that cylinder's own span. quiddity-rust licenses it under Apache-2.0.
